# Complete ODQ-102D Owner Disposition

Decision: `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-102D-01`, approved as one indivisible base-v0.1
design in `SCI-NOI_OWNER_DECISION_SUPPLEMENT v0.1/r0.3`, SHA-256
`4b622de96e72860e544bf3699e3a131bc9cca5d2be0b0fe5bb41096327e977e5`.

The exact controlling bytes are the supplement's numbered 19-clause decision
and conditional-uniformity statement. Normative projections are
`SCI-NOI-EQ-003..004`, `SCI-NOI-EQ-008..009`,
`SCI-NOI-REQ-010..016`, and `SCI-NOI-PRED-001..002`, `-005`, `-014..016`.

The accepted family is independent symmetric Rademacher candidate generation
before conditioning, exact active-stratum tolerance in `[0,1)`, first-accepted
bounded rejection, fail-closed cap exhaustion, with-replacement draws, no
forced complement pair, retained distinct duplicates and complement orbits,
equal `1/N_resolved` weights, uncentered active sign-matrix rank, and frozen
content-bound scheduling-independent reconstruction identity.

Conditional uniformity follows because each admitted vector has identical base
probability and identical summed probability of all possible earlier rejection
prefixes. The retry cap affects the shared normalization/resolution probability
but not relative accepted-vector probabilities.
